svg.title: Three panels of a Swiss roll coloured by position along the sheet: the roll seen end-on as a spiral, its PCA projection where layers overlap, and its t-SNE embedding, with the t-SNE objective under them
svg.text: A Swiss roll is a 2-D sheet curled up in 3-D: PCA flattens it badly, t-SNE keeps neighbours together

g.text: what t-SNE minimised: KL divergence against step

svg.text: Colour is each point's true position along the sheet, so a good layout is a smooth colour gradient. PCA overlaps layers of the roll; t-SNE keeps
neighbours together but cuts the sheet into pieces rather than unrolling it.
